caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair features a dark brown wood grain texture and coloring, with three horizontal slats forming the backrest. The seat is a lighter shade of brown, differentiated from the darker wooden frame, and appears to be made from a solid material. The legs of the chair are supported by additional horizontal connecting rods, and the bottom consists of two curved rockers. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and shading, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature. There are no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Colonial Rocker
